sections.ingredients:
Hathi ki lida (Elephant’s dung) – 100 kg

sections.description_of_ingredients:
Hathi’s Lida – Elephant’s dung is made from a variety of plants and leaves and has more medicinal properties. Inhaling the smoke of the dung will heal the headache and also relieves form toothache. Paste of this dung is helpful in treating skin issues. 
 Hathi Mutra – Elephant’s urine is salty in taste and is effective in worm infestation and various skin disorders. Also it is useful in constipation, urine retention, piles etc.  
 Bakuchi Churna – This powder has a sweet and bitter taste. So it is useful in Pitta disorders. It is effective in skin disorders. 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take this dung and properly burn this dung over flames. 
 Take that burnt part for about 12 kg and properly filtrate. 
 Then mix this with urine (13 litres). 
 Then decant this mixture for approximately 24 hours. 
 Next day remove the blackish part. 
 Kept this mixture in stainless steel container. 
 Take that 12 kg elephant’s dung and mix 1/10 part of bakuchi churna and heat over low flame. 
 When urine is dried off then place this medicine in the tray. 
 Make 1-1 gm tablets and kept in glass container. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Avalgujadi gutika is an Ayurvedic formulation and very effective in Vitiligo disease (a skin disorder). The ingredients in this formulation has Astringent property which purifies blood and also pacifies pitta Dosha. This is also used in various skin disorders.

Vitiligo 
 Leucoderma 
 Psoriasis 

 How To Apply 
 Apply over affected part after abrading the tablet with water twice a day. 
 Cautions 
 Take under medical supervision. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Avalgujadi Gutika 
 Reference – Bhaishajya-Ratnavali Kushtharogadhikar 864/47-48 
 Introduction 
 Avalgujadi gutika is an Ayurvedic formulation which is made from Elephant dung and urine. This is effective medicine for Kushtha roga (skin diseases). 
 Ingredients 
 
 Hathi ki lida (Elephant’s dung) – 100 kg 
 Hathi mutra (Elephant’s urine) – 13 litre 
 Bakuchi churna (Psoralea corylifolia) – 1200 gms 
 
 Description of Ingredients 
 
 Hathi’s Lida – Elephant’s dung is made from a variety of plants and leaves and has more medicinal properties. Inhaling the smoke of the dung will heal the headache and also relieves form toothache. Paste of this dung is helpful in treating skin issues. 
 Hathi Mutra – Elephant’s urine is salty in taste and is effective in worm infestation and various skin disorders. Also it is useful in constipation, urine retention, piles etc.  
 Bakuchi Churna – This powder has a sweet and bitter taste. So it is useful in Pitta disorders. It is effective in skin disorders. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take this dung and properly burn this dung over flames. 
 Take that burnt part for about 12 kg and properly filtrate. 
 Then mix this with urine (13 litres). 
 Then decant this mixture for approximately 24 hours. 
 Next day remove the blackish part. 
 Kept this mixture in stainless steel container. 
 Take that 12 kg elephant’s dung and mix 1/10 part of bakuchi churna and heat over low flame. 
 When urine is dried off then place this medicine in the tray. 
 Make 1-1 gm tablets and kept in glass container. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Avalgujadi gutika is an Ayurvedic formulation and very effective in Vitiligo disease (a skin disorder). The ingredients in this formulation has Astringent property which purifies blood and also pacifies pitta Dosha. This is also used in various skin disorders. 
 Indications

 How To Apply

 Cautions 
 Take under medical supervision. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
